note: What this repository is measured against. `flixSpec` is the commit of wstein/flix-spec that scripts/fetch-spec.mjs materialises into the gitignored .spec/ cache; `contentDigest` is a SHA-256 over the sorted (path, content-digest) pairs of the fetched subset, so the cache is verified by content rather than by a tarball byte-image that GitHub does not promise to keep stable. `flix` is the reference release flix-spec itself pins, copied here so the language version this grammar targets is readable without opening a second repository. Nothing under .spec/ is committed: flix-spec owns those files, and a second copy in this repository could only ever be a stale one.
